description: Timoria McQueen Saba for Georgia House District 68, bringing proven advocacy and policy experience to meet the real needs of Georgia families. As a mother and someone who has battled life-threatening health issues, she understands the need for healthcare accessibility and affordability. From advancing equitable healthcare and tackling food insecurity to supporting families, workers, and every community, Timoria will listen, lead, and fight to deliver a bold plan for a better Georgia, building a safer, healthier, and more empowered future for every family.
